name: headroom-0370
install_doc: THOL's own `headroom` arm pins 0.27.0, which is ten minor versions behind what a user installs today. This arm installs the current release into its own uv tool directory so both can run in one campaign: the pinned arm keeps our numbers comparable to THOL's published board, this one measures what someone would actually get. Installed by bench/thol/Dockerfile.headroom037.
notes: Same entry point and mode as THOL's pinned arm -- `headroom wrap claude` starts the proxy and sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL so all API traffic is compacted with no agent opt-in. Only the version differs, which is the point: any difference between this arm and `headroom` is ten minors of their work, not a configuration choice of ours.
